quotes.quote: Every little action of the common day makes or unmakes character.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: When what you hear and what you see don't match, trust your eyes.
quotes.author: Dale Renton

quotes.quote: It's the best, Jerry, the best!
quotes.author: Bania in The Sein

quotes.quote: Give people a common enemy and you will give them a common identity. Deprive them of an enemy and you will deprive them of the crutch by which they know who they are.
quotes.author: James Alison
